_doc: Palettes a PixelLab picture can be held to (`tools/pixellab.py object|building --palette <name>`, PixelLab's `target_palette`), so new art keeps D40's muted, earthy look. `muted`: 48 colours taken by median cut from the art already in the game (the Tower's inside props, the lands' plants and landmarks, the sworn blade's body), 2026-10-21, D358.
